title: Anjaneya
desc: A police officer goes undercover to infiltrate the mafia and collect incriminating evidence. During his operation, he receives assistance from Divya, who begins to have romantic feelings for him.

title: Karaikkal Ammaiyar
desc: Paramathathan is an atheist who marries Punithavathi, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva. Their conflicting beliefs in God create problems in their married life.

title: Sathan Sollai Thattathey
desc: Murthy, Gopinath and Sekar, three friends, unintentionally fall for the same girl, Chitra. However, their lives unexpectedly change when they accidentally release a genie from an antique violin.

title: Sugamana Sumaigal
desc: Murthy is the sole breadwinner of his large family. However, when he discovers that he has cancer and his days are numbered, he challenges fate and does everything he can to secure his family.

title: Senthamizh Paattu
desc: Despite his mother's objection to singing songs, Bala develops an interest in music. He falls in love with Durga, a rich girl with whose family his mother's miseries are interlinked.
